labels.notes: Row partial and unmarked (docstring line 13 names the label without the bold mark; REPORT status partial, marked false); the remaining blockers OQ-120 (b), OQ-124, OQ-116 (a) are disclosed in the docstring, the checklist and SCOPE (a). Moved-p reading: IsIsoVia (HSAntipodal, pre-existing) with B in Causal.Flat.lorentz 2, which #print confirms is minkQ-preserving, future-causal-preserving and det 1, i.e. SO0(1,2) as l.616-623; IsIso.isIsoVia_one shows the same-p notion is the case B = 1, so the moved form is the stronger. Repelling-endpoint reading: IsSpacelikePositiveRep / IsSpacelikeNegativeAtt keep the existential frame of HSSingularities' IsSpacelikePositive verbatim (dS2 point, oriented theta, lifted pair, k >= 1, g with a fixed point, g hyperbolic, f = delta^k g) and replace only the last conjunct by 'for every t in I+ = D(E^-1 i+(L)), sInf (connectedComponentIn I+ t) is IsRepellingAt / IsAttractingAt g'. IsRepellingAt / IsAttractingAt are the pre-existing HSSingularities definitions (fixed and |y-x| < |gy-x| on a punctured neighbourhood), not new; sInf of the connected component is the left extremity of a bounded open interval component (connectedComponentIn_iUnion_Ioo_two, csInf_Ioo), the same points as the paper's x_{2i}. The guard 'g hyperbolic, k >= 1' is the paper's own (l.893-895). The equivalence is not definitional: forms_iff_of_consecutive does the sign analysis of g - id on both sides of consecutive fixed points. Not tailored. Assembly statement checked: (iii) in both forms, for IsIso and for every IsIsoVia; the forms equal for every C; at every p in dS2 a positive (both forms) and negative (both forms) pair with isomorphic RP1-circles and no IsIso / IsIsoVia between them. OQ-128: its recorded finding is that l.915 and l.908-913 differ at trivial holonomy and that the degree-4 example fails the hyperbolic guard; forms_iff_iff_ne_one sharpens this (unguarded, for one lifted pair at p in dS2 with k >= 1 and g with a fixed point, the forms agree iff g != 1) and exists_forms_differ is consistent with it. No contradiction.

findings.what: The REPORT says the forms part at trivial holonomy 'in every even degree, the regular link l(p) (degree 2) included'. forms_iff_iff_ne_one is universal over lifted pairs, but the only instance built is degree 4 (exists_forms_differ). That l(p) itself, or a circle in every even degree, has a lifted pair with f = delta^k and g = 1 is not formalized here. The claim is very likely true (linkCover has period 2), but it reaches the author as a fact.
